select jsonb_build_object('database',current_database(),'private_schema_present',to_regnamespace('private')is not null,'identity_relation_present',to_regclass('private.cloudtms_database_identity')is not null,'migration_ledger_present',to_regclass('private.cloudtms_migration_ledger')is not null,'repeatable_ledger_present',to_regclass('private.cloudtms_repeatable_ledger')is not null,
 'current_user',current_user,'session_user',session_user,'protected_owner',(select pg_get_userbyid(proowner)from pg_proc where oid=to_regprocedure('private.weekly_source_protected_qualification_owner_v1()')),
 'protected_owner_helper_present',to_regprocedure('private.weekly_source_protected_qualification_owner_v1()')is not null,
 'protected_owner_helper_body_matches',coalesce((select coalesce((p.oid is not null and md5(p.prosrc)='7dcc1e303ab436298d7a3fa1ebc61807' and p.prosecdef=false and p.provolatile='s' and (select lanname from pg_language where oid=p.prolang)='plpgsql' and cardinality(p.proconfig)=1 and replace(replace(p.proconfig[1],' ',''),'"','')='search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp'),false)from pg_proc p where oid=to_regprocedure('private.weekly_source_protected_qualification_owner_v1()')),false),
 'service_helper_present',to_regprocedure('private.weekly_source_query_require_service_v1()')is not null,
 'service_helper_body_matches',coalesce((select coalesce((p.oid is not null and md5(p.prosrc)='237c30e8fdce7bf84d2002d0e669cdd3' and p.prosecdef=true and p.provolatile='s' and (select lanname from pg_language where oid=p.prolang)='plpgsql' and cardinality(p.proconfig)=1 and replace(replace(p.proconfig[1],' ',''),'"','')='search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp'),false)from pg_proc p where oid=to_regprocedure('private.weekly_source_query_require_service_v1()')),false),
 'existing_service_claim_context',coalesce(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role',true),nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims',true),'')::jsonb->>'role','')='service_role',
 'roles',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',rolname,'superuser',rolsuper,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls)order by rolname)from pg_roles where rolname in('anon','authenticated','service_role')),
 'existing_acl',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',e.signature,'present',p.oid is not null,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),
 'anon_execute',case when exists(select 1 from pg_roles where rolname='anon')then has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE')end,
 'authenticated_execute',case when exists(select 1 from pg_roles where rolname='authenticated')then has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE')end,
 'service_execute',case when exists(select 1 from pg_roles where rolname='service_role')then has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE')end)order by e.signature)
 from(values ('private.weekly_source_query_require_service_v1()'),('public.weekly_source_message_dispatch_submission_start_atomic_v1(jsonb)'),('public.weekly_source_message_dispatch_result_atomic_v1(jsonb)'),('private.weekly_source_protected_qualification_owner_v1()'))e(signature)left join pg_proc p on p.oid=to_regprocedure(e.signature)),
 'scope','CATALOGUE_AND_EXISTING_CONTEXT_ONLY','api_role_proof','NOT_RUN')as contact_component_preflight;
